name: sys
resume: All 11 exports of sys 3.4.3 are done. Processes are started with subprocess. The import name is r_sys because sys is the Python standard library. exec_status returns the wait status word, so exit 1 is 256. eval_safe and eval_fork warn and then report that unix is not installed. There is no crate.

check.case: as_text of a newline-terminated a and b

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sys))
one <- function() {
  paste(as_text(charToRaw("a\nb\n")), collapse = "|")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

functions.done: Deprecated. The unix package is not translated.

check.case: eval_fork warns and reports that unix is not installed

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sys))
one <- function() {
    warn <- ""
    err <- ""
    withCallingHandlers(
      tryCatch(eval_fork(1), error = function(e) err <<- conditionMessage(e)),
      warning = function(w) { warn <<- conditionMessage(w); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }
    )
    paste(gsub("\n", " / ", warn), err, sep = " || ")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time
import warnings
from r_sys import eval_fork

def one():
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            try:
                eval_fork(1)
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                message = " / ".join(str(item.message).replace("\n", " / ") for item in caught)
                return message + " || " + str(exc)
        return "missing"

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
    shown = "|".join("" if item is None else str(item) for item in value)
elif value is None:
    shown = "NULL"
else:
    shown = str(value)
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
